I purchased the E-210 about a month or so ago. This was the first Weber I had ever purchased. As I was assembling it I noticed the rear panel was shorter than what was in the manual. No problem, yet. However, when I went to attach it to the side panels I noticed the 2 upper holes on the side panels were much higher than would accommodate the 2 upper holes for the rear panel. See the photos. I would have only been able to screw in the 2 lower screws of the rear panel, not the upper ones. I would have been fine with the small back panel but Weber did not give me the correct side panels for this new back panel. 

Weber did ship out a replacement part, but I shouldn't have had a part that didn't fit in the first place.

Results.ReviewText:
We got the Weber Spirit E-210 Gas Grill several weeks ago and have used it extensively for grilling bratwurst, steaks, hamburgers, corn, vegetables, barbecued ribs--you name it. It has met our expectations in every respect. My impressions as follows:

THE GOOD

The grill is solidly built. The title of this review ($200) refers to a gas grill of a different make but similar size purchased by my daughter awhile back. She paid about $200 less for hers than we paid for ours, but the difference in build quality is huge! Hers, while it functions well, is primarily thin sheet metal construction. The Spirit E-210 is solid. I estimate that it is at least twice as heavy as hers and is obviously built to last. This holds true for cooking and burner surfaces as well: solidly made and heavy. Oh--just a quick mention. I spent half a day assembling my daughter's grill. We purchased ours already assembled--AND Ace Hardware helped us load it. 

It is compact. One of the criteria for us (retired couple living in Florida) was a grill small enough to be accommodated in a limited space. The Spirit E-210 has inside propane tank storage and side table flaps that fold down for storage. When not in use it occupies a space just a little over 2' x 2' x 3.5' tall, fitting nicely into a corner of our lanai.

It heats fast and evenly--no apparent "cool" areas once it was heated and ready to cook. It was amazing to watch the temp. gauge rise once we turned it on with both burners on high: the needle was close to the 600 degree mark in just a few minutes. The solid build of the unit, especially the cover which sits solidly on the frame, helps keep heat in instead of radiating a lot of it away. Additionally the burners are responsive: it can cook "low and slow" for ribs, or hot enough to produce a medium NY Strip Steak in less than 9 minutes. The indirect heat is nice as well. Though it gets very hot, no flame ever contacts the food (though grease flares will happen).

THE BAD

Well, maybe "The Not Quite Up To Expectations" would be a better title for this section, because there is nothing really bad about this unit. But...

The casters, while totally functional, seem a bit small for the unit. It is a heavy unit and casters possibly a bit bigger would be a big help rolling it over uneven surfaces, or in and out of our lanai. We have to lift up the end being rolled over the threshold--a minor annoyance, but still there. 

Another condition larger casters would help alleviate is that the wheel brakes on the unit (each front caster has a toe brake which can be set so the unit doesn't roll accidentally), can only be set with the front wheels at near 90 degrees to the unit. If not, the brake lever cannot be reached with a toe and we have to reach under the unit to adjust the wheel to the correct position. 

The warming rack, while perfectly usable, is a bit small. Maybe 6" wider would increase its functionality.

The gas bottle rides on a clip inside the unit that also functions as a measuring device to tell you how much gas is left. I've never used (or even seen) one of those before so I am just a little nervous about it...like a solution for which there is no problem. But hey! Maybe it is great. Time will tell.

THE UGLY

There ain't no ugly!

THE BOTTOM LINE

Frankly, so far this grill has exceeded our expectations...and we expected a lot! Obviously we cannot assess its longevity at this point but the good design and heavy build quality leaves little room for doubt that it will shine in that area as well. I'd certainly recommend it.
Results.Title: What a Difference $200 Makes!

Results.ReviewText:
Although we have had a number of Weber grills throughout our years, we went away to try another brand.  Mistake.  We returned to Weber with the purchase of our 210.

For the two of us it is a great size and provides plenty of space for burgers and dogs when all six of us are together.  It heats up quickly and the flat grill plates give a nice marking to the food.  Chicken breasts, kabobs, burgers, brats, steaks, all cook nicely.  Heat has decent control.

The fold down side shelves provide ample work space, and storage during cooking.  The tool hangers on each one will let you store your favorite utensils. The fact that they fold away is a blessing here In Colorado with the windy conditions.  Allows the cover to be kept tightly against the grill with the covers straps pulled snugly.

Love the included gas cylinder fuel gauge.  Gives you a good estimate of fuel availability.  Build quality is very good and it looks great.  Not complicated and simple is always better.
Results.Title: Great Smaller Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are really sorry to hear this happened. It must have been a very scary experience for you. We are here to help. Our manual does suggest checking for gas leaks before using the grill with soapy water. If a gas leak is present we do not suggest using the grill. Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up with you and ask additional questions to determine what happened. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: My grill exploded on 3rd use. We were fortunate that there were no serious injuries. It had a strange humming sound every time it was lit. The fire marshal and fire inspector both felt that it had a bad regulator but there was not enough left of the grill to send out to lab for confirmation. We purchased it at Lowe’s and they assembled it and delivered it to our deck. It was not even completely paid for. Our home is total brick and fire marshal said that is what saved it from burning. We have total loss of our deck. To be clear the grill lit normally (every time) and it exploded during use 10 minutes into the process. This needs to be investigated before it causes extensive loss of property or life. Terrible experience..
Results.Title: Please investigate this

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Spirit, after many years of the previous one. With the new one (received 2 months ago) I had two issues: 1) when lowering the position from high to medium (after it reached the 450/500F in high) the temperature barely came down; 2) during a windy day, when moving from top position to medium the fire went out (even though the grill is not in a totally open area). This never happened with my previous grill. Please comment. Thanks

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
